QF.id: IV Clearing Settlement and Risk Management_37

question.text: At what level of collateral utilization does the exchange cancel all unexecuted orders of a clearing member?

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the workbook's risk-reduction mode rules, once a clearing member's collateral utilisation breaches 90%, the exchange cancels all unexecuted orders of that member as a containment measure. The Trap: 80% is not the source-stated cancellation trigger; 95% and 100% are too late. The 90% threshold is the specific level at which risk-reduction mode is activated and pending orders are pulled. Note: Pages 261 and 275 (sample question) confirm 90% as the risk-reduction trigger and the cancellation of unexecuted orders once it is breached.
